scope: Archive one reviewed operator attestation immediately before each registered-science submission. POSIX mkdirat does not return a descriptor, so the control plane cannot enforce same-account process isolation from exclusive directory creation until no-follow descriptor and retained-ancestry binding complete. Workload-created descendants have a corresponding isolation interval through their post-action recursive-capture handoff. Retained descriptor and ancestry checks reject later substitution of observed identities. This template records the remaining operational prerequisite without representing it as an enforceable site security boundary.
operator_statement: Reviewed same-account process snapshot immediately before registered submission; no competing process is authorized to mutate the PIC roots throughout registered launch and publication until the frozen artifact inventory is durably published.
